gb_matrix.description: Deformation parameters gb_{sigma,j,s}: rows = fermionic oscillator a_1^sigma, columns = bosonic oscillator b_j^s
gb_matrix.parity_note: gb are scalar coefficients of the odd (boson-fermion) block of the pre-oscillator form; the 'parity 1' of C_inhomogeneous_definition.md refers to that block. [b, a] is odd and kappa is odd, so gb itself is an even scalar.

deformed_oscillator_relations.description: [b_j^s, a_1^sigma] = -gb_{sigma,j,s} * kappa ; all other oscillator relations unchanged

inhomogeneous_deformation.description: [X, Y]_gamma = [X, Y]_0 + kappa * gamma(X, Y); gamma(X,Y) = sum_Z coeff * Z
inhomogeneous_deformation.codomain: g (+) C K : entries with Z = 'K' are the constant (central) components
inhomogeneous_deformation.coefficient_format: coeff: polynomial in gb as a string; coeff_terms: {monomial: rational}
inhomogeneous_deformation.pairs_stored: all ordered pairs (X, Y) with gamma(X, Y) != 0
